title: LLM competitive intelligence ops roadmap and signal-harvest pipeline
creator: Lena Morris
description: Problem: Engineering and GTM teams lack a single operational process for surfacing model-landscape signals (new open checkpoints, quantization profiles, pricing changes, license shifts, sponge/throughput tradeoffs) and translating those signals into prioritized product recommendations. Goal: Define a repeatable ops roadmap + lightweight pipeline (weekly signal harvest -> enrichment -> triage -> product impact scoring) and ship an initial capability matrix + prototype dashboard that stakeholders can query and that powers a weekly digest for PMs, Runtime, and Sales.
tasks: Stakeholder interviews (Runtime, Applied ML, Sales ENG, Solutions) — capture current pain points and existing sources
Inventory data sources: model hubs, community repos, model card feeds, repos (Hugging Face, GitHub), vendor pricing pages, Slack/Discord channels, academic arXiv alerts
Design capability matrix schema: fields, taxonomy (capabilities, sequence-length profiles, quantization support, latency/throughput benchmarks, license/usage restrictions, exemplar use-cases)
Build minimal ETL for signal harvest (cron job + parsers) that ingests 10+ sources and deduplicates model mentions
Define scoring rubric for product impact (customer-fit, infra-cost delta, reliability risk, legal/compliance flag)
Prototype a read-only dashboard (Metabase/Looker/Console) showing top-moving models, gaps vs Redwood catalog, and recommended actions
Connect eval harness: wire key model entries to existing eval prompts so PMs can quickly validate quality regressions
Ship weekly digest email template and Slack channel automation for triage
Run pilot with Runtime and two PMs for 4 weeks, collect feedback and tune thresholds
acceptance_criteria: Capability matrix populated with >=40 unique model entries (open & gated) and at least 8 schema fields per entry
Automated pipeline runs weekly and ingests signals from >=10 distinct sources with de-duplication working
Dashboard shows model delta trends and a small set of actionable tags (cost-up, license-change, new-quantized-variant)
Scoring rubric produces a prioritized watchlist of at least 10 items with explicit recommended product actions
Runbook documented: how to add sources, how to interpret scores, and ownership for weekly triage
Pilot feedback from Runtime and two PMs with at least 6 improvement requests logged and a plan to address high-priority items
